normalized_matching_profile.description: **Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. WaterColor - Spartina Circle #154 brought to you by Beach Blue Properties. Steps to Pool, Close to Beach, 6-Seat LSV (Low Speed Vehicle), Amenity Bands Included for Beach Club! 154 Spartina Circe is located in the beloved Camp District at Watercolor! Our warm and welcoming home is perfectly situated across the street from Wood Fern Park, the newly renovated Camp Watercolor, and one of the largest swimming pools in Watercolor. Enjoy the beautiful park, playground, splashpad, swimming pool, fishing pond, and more – all just steps from your front door! Our charming and well-loved 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom home is nestled among the trees in one of the most sought-after locations on 30A! This reasonably priced, family friendly getaway offers a host of amazing features including pinewood floors, custom tile work, top of the line appliances, custom built-ins, a gas fireplace, two master suites (one up and one down), two additional bedrooms each with private baths, large closets with plenty of storage, and 12-foot ceilings upstairs. The first floor even features a quiet office space for catching up on emails or posting all those fabulous vacation photos! The gourmet kitchen and farm table dining areas are perfect for family gatherings and act as the centerpiece of this relaxed space. For your convenience, there is ample storage for groceries and a utility closet located in the hallway. Expansive first and second floor porches provide peaceful places to relax, and a partially covered side deck offers additional space for outdoor entertaining. There is even a unique rain chain to watch when tropical rains pass over and a gas grill outside. Three parking areas at the back of the house and additional parking pads across the street offer ample room for multiple family vehicles. For your convenience, the house has a full laundry room, and WIFI is complimentary. 1st Level: Screened Front Porch Living Room Gourmet Kitchen Dining Area Office –private work area Master Suite – king bed Master Suite – stone tiled shower, bathtub, double vanity 2nd Level: Master Suite - king bed, balcony access Master Bathroom – stone tiled shower, double vanity Guest Bedroom – king bed Guest Bathroom – shower tub combo Guest Bedroom – king bed, balcony access Guest Bathroom - shower tub combo Laundry Room with full washer and dryer WaterColor is a unique, amenity rich environment with no shortage of leisure and recreational activities. In addition to the brilliant blue water and white sand at the beach, there are acres of parks with walking and biking trails throughout the community. Other amenities include the WaterColor Shops and Town Center, a state of the art fitness center, bicycle rentals (none included), an impressive tennis facility with five HarTru Hydro Courts (three lighted for evening play) and a full service pro shop. From fine to very casual dining, WaterColor and the surrounding communities along 30A have it all. The Watercolor Owners Association only allows up to 8 armbands for guests, no exceptions. Guests will have to register through the WOA portal prior to arrival after BBP enters them in the system. Children 4 years of age and under do not have to wear armbands. Per the WOA: lost bands are $50 each to replace. No pets or ESA permitted. CANCELLATION: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
